transcript: My father gave me a small box Inside were old photographs and one letter He had kept them safe for a long time In one photo My young father smiled next to my grandfather. This is my childhood, he whispered softly. I came to see the ordinary box as something precious. I had never imagined that a piece of paper could carry such worth. Father taught me about the bonds and affection within a family Not with words, but quietly The photograph gave me comfort, he said I give you this And the small gift carried years of respect and memory I nodded to my father and accepted the box A gentle desire to give something back grew in my heart
